title: Crunchyroll Confirms Streaming Details of 2026’s Biggest Anime Return of The Year
content:
Based on the 2013 action fantasy light novel written by Carlo Zen and illustrated by Shinobu Shinotsuki, Saga of Tanya the Evil released a manga adaptation in 2016 and an anime series in 2017. The series is famous for its WWI-style world, combined with realistic military strategy and intense action, following a reincarnated protagonist who is completely unfamiliar with the world. The anime aired 12 episodes in the first season before returning with a sequel film in February 2019. Over six years have passed since then, with almost no updates regarding the highly anticipated Season 2. The anime announced a second season four years ago, confirming that the cast and crew will be the same. Yasushi Uemura will return as the director, while Yuji Hosogoe will again be the character designer and the Chief Animation Director. Additionally, Kento Ihara will also rejoin the crew as the scriptwriter. These details were shared alongside the Season 2 announcement, confirming that the anime is under production. After several years of silence from the studio, fans will be getting a new update. According to @MangaMoguraRE on X, a reliable source of information on a number of anime and manga series, Saga of Tanya the Evil will soon reveal new information. The post immediately began circulating in the fandom as fans couldn’t hide their excitement over the series’s return. While the details of the announcement are scarce, we may expect something new within this month.

Saga of Tanya the Evil Is a Unique Fantasy Isekai

The story stands out for following a ruthless protagonist who happens to be an amoral reincarnation of a cynical salaryman from modern-day Japan, reborn as a young girl named Tanya Degurechaff in a war-torn, alternate version of early 20th-century Europe. She is known for her selfish, pragmatic, and cruel actions that send shivers down the spines of her enemies. The story follows the protagonist who challenged Being X, a self-proclaimed God, to a battle of wits and ended up being reincarnated as a little girl in a war-struck world where magic is primarily used for military purposes.

Now known as Tanya, the protagonist swears to climb through the ranks of the country’s military. However, Being X still proves to be the biggest obstacle in Tanya’s attempt to rebuild a peaceful life for herself. Despite Being X’s desire to make her suffer, Tanya makes the best of the situation she’s been put in and manages to impress the higher-ups with her aptitude for war.

Going through several trials and tribulations, we follow Tanya’s journey as she strives to escape the self-proclaimed God’s influence, as she is embroiled in a war where she seeks world domination. Both the anime’s first season and the sequel film are currently available to stream on Crunchyroll, one of the biggest anime streaming platforms for fans across the globe. Additionally, the light novel has been published in English by Yen Press under the Yen On imprint since December 19, 2017.

title: 'Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei' Part 2 in Production
content:
The official website of the Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei ( The Irregular at Magic High School ) anime series announced on Friday that a second part is in production, revealing a teaser visual (pictured).

Madhouse produced the first anime season adapting Tsutomu Satou 's action sci-fi light novel debuted in 26 episodes in Spring 2014. The Hoshi wo Yobu Shoujo ( The Girl Who Summons The Stars ) anime movie by 8bit opened in Japan in June 2017.

The Raihousha-hen ( Visitor Arc ) television anime aired in Fall 2020, followed by the Tsuioku-hen ( Reminiscence Arc ) prequel special in December 2021.

The third season premiered in 13 episodes in Spring 2024, followed by the Yotsuba Keishou-hen ( Yotsuba Succession Arc ) sequel movie on May 8.

A television anime adaptation of Satou and Yu Mori 's Mahouka Koukou no Yuutousei ( The Honor at Magic High School ) spin-off manga by animation studio Connect aired in Summer 2021.

Satou originally published the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in 2008. Kadokawa began releasing the title under its Dengeki Bunko label with illustrations by Kana Ishida in July 2011 and published the 32nd and final volume in September 2020.

Satou launched the Magian Company sequel light novel the following month. Kadokawa shipped the 11th volume on March 10. Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei has a cumulative 30 million copies of its volumes in print.

Yen Press licensed the light novel in English in 2015 and published the 26th volume on February 10.

title: Chainsaw Man Creator’s Most Underrated Show Gets a New Release
content: Best known for creating acclaimed manga such as Chainsaw Man and Fire Punch , Tatsuki Fujimoto has released several intriguing series and one-shots over his decade-long career. His one-shot, Look Back , which was released in 2021, received an anime film adaptation by Studio DURIAN, and it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to consider it the best anime film of 2024. The nuanced story with emotional moments was already well-loved among fans before the film adaptation, but its popularity skyrocketed after the anime’s premiere. On March 13th, 2026, the film will release a special Sketchbook collection and hold a signing session with director Kiyotaka Oshiyama.

title: Acclaimed Action Series Gets a New Story After Surprise Hiatus
content:
Bungo Stray Dogs is an acclaimed supernatural action series written by Kafka Asagiri and illustrated by Sango Harukawa. The manga began serializing in 2012 in Kadokawa Shoten’s Young Ace magazine and was later adapted into an anime by Studio Bones, almost four years after the manga’s debut. In 2016, the anime made its debut and eventually gained recognition across the globe. Over the past decade, the franchise has released five seasons, a film, and even spin-offs. The latest season was released in 2023, and the anime has yet to officially renew the series for a sixth season as Atsushi and the others face more threats. While the anime teased the story’s continuation, the studio has yet to share any details on the continuation. As the wait grows longer, the anime is commemorating its 10th anniversary and has even launched an official website to announce multiple projects as part of the celebration.

What’s Next For Bungo Stray Dogs ?

Since the anime is commemorating its 10th anniversary this year, the franchise is all set to unveil exciting surprises for fans. Apart from an exhibition which will only be held in Tokyo, the anime also confirmed a new project where Harukawa will unveil 35 new original visuals while the manga is on hiatus. The first visual features Kyouka, surrounded by Atsushi, Akutagawa, Dazai, and Chuuya. We can also expect more updates on the anime as the project has only just begun.

The manga is currently on hiatus after concluding the first part, and there are no updates about its return. The story took an unexpected turn with a fair share of tragedies and intense battles before concluding Part 1, and the upcoming part is expected to be just as intense. By the time the fifth season wrapped up three years ago, the anime had already caught up with the manga, leaving no source material to adapt in Season 6.

However, even though the manga has more content for the story’s continuation, there’s no confirmation that the story will return anytime soon. All seasons of the original anime, the film, and the spin-off are currently streaming on Crunchyroll. The manga has released 28 volumes so far, out of which 27 have already been translated into English. Additionally, the English release date of Volume 28 hasn’t been revealed.

title: The Irregular at Magic High School Anime Part 1 Ends After 12 Years, Part 2 Announced
content:
The production committee for The Irregular at Magic High School ‘s anime announced on June 5 that development had begun on the anime’s second part. You can check out the announcement visual below.

The announcement of The Irregular at Magic High School Part 2’s development start follows the release of The Irregular at Magic High School Yotsuba Succession Arc in May 2026. Animec (a joint venture between KADOKAWA and Aniplex) distributed the film in Japan.

Crunchyroll streams the second and third seasons of The Irregular at Magic High School , describing the anime: Based on the light novel by Tsutomu Sato, The Irregular at Magic High School is set in a world where magic exists but instead of using chants and spells, magic users cast spells with their Casting Assistant Device (CAD). The CAD is infused with the user’s Psions (a substance-less thought particle) that activates the device and constructs the magic ritual.

The Irregular at Magic High School anime Part 2 will continue the adaptation of Sato’s novels, published by KADOKAWA, and with over 22 million copies in circulation. Madhouse adapted the first TV anime season in 2014, followed by Eight Bit for the following seasons and movies.

title: The Irregular at Magic High School Anime Launches Production on 'Part II'
content:
The official portal site for The irregular at magic high school television anime announced with a visual on Friday that production on the anime's "Part II" is launching. The announcement did not specify the release venue of Part II.

Tsutomu Satou 's The irregular at magic high school ( Mahōka Kōkō no Rettōsei ) light novel series launched in 2008, and ended with the 32nd volume in September 2020. Two sequels shipped in October 2020 and January 2021.

The irregular at magic high school TV anime premiered in April 2014 and aired for 26 episodes. A second season, titled The Irregular at Magic High School: Visitor Arc , premiered in October 2020 and ran for 13 episodes. The anime franchise also includes The irregular at magic high school The Movie: The Girl Who Summons the Stars film, which opened in Japan in June 2017. The Honor Student at Magic High School manga inspired a 13-episode TV anime that premiered in July 2021.

The irregular at magic high school anime's third television season premiered in April 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired with English subtitles and an English dub .

The Mahōka Kōkō no Rettōsei: Yotsuba Keishō-hen ( T he Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE - Yotsuba Succession Arc - ) anime film had a premiere screening on April 28 at Shinjuku Wald 9 before opening in Japan on May 8.

Yen Press publishes the original The irregular at magic high school light novel series and Yu Mori 's The Honor Student at Magic High School spinoff manga.

title: Almost 10 Years Later, an Anime Series Looks Ready to Succeed a Masterpiece Film (And It Looks Perfect)
content:
Summer is approaching, bringing exciting new entertainment, including in the anime industry. The upcoming anime season is set to continue the trend established by the first two seasons, with older anime returning for new installments that expand their stories while new series continue to debut. This season, however, the new anime are standing out more than the returning titles, and Summer appears to be following the same pattern. While the season is packed with major action anime, the slice-of-life genre is drawing even more attention.

The Summer season will feature some of the most unusual slice-of-life romance anime released in recent years. However, there are also more traditional entries in the genre, with one in particular looking to capture the appeal of the classic slice-of-life film A Silent Voice . The movie has become a masterpiece of the anime medium thanks to its grounded portrayal of romance and life’s struggles. The dynamic between its protagonists is especially compelling, as Shoko’s condition ultimately helps Shoya find purpose and move forward with his life. A somewhat similar theme is set to be explored in Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky , which is scheduled to premiere this Summer.

Summer 2026 Could Have the Perfect Replacement For A Silent Voice

Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky follows Kakeru Sorano, a shy and timid university student who befriends Koharu Fuyutsuki, a girl with the complete opposite personality. The twist, however, is that Koharu is blind. Despite her condition, she radiates an infectious energy that inspires Kakeru to view life from a different perspective. Koharu dreams of launching fireworks, an intriguing aspiration for someone who cannot see them, and Kakeru becomes determined to help her achieve that simple dream. Together, they embark on a journey defined by a unique dynamic and challenging circumstances that will shape their lives.

Koharu’s condition is clearly similar to Shoko’s in A Silent Voice . Despite their disabilities, neither allows their condition to define them, instead choosing to embrace life and move forward with optimism. Another similarity is how their circumstances ultimately inspire the male protagonists in their lives, changing their outlook and helping them grow as individuals. It is an emotional dynamic that highlights how, no matter how difficult life may be, there is always something worth looking forward to.

Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky appears poised to embrace this theme and emerge as one of the most heartwarming slice-of-life anime of the season, on a level comparable to beloved films such as A Silent Voice and I Want to Eat Your Pancreas . The anime premieres on July 6, and while its streaming platforms have not yet been announced, fans can reasonably expect it to arrive on Crunchyroll.
